basic_details.short_information: The Department of Visual Arts, UCSSH, Mohanlal Sukhadia University (MLSU), Udaipur, will hold a walk-in interview on 13 November 2026 at 11:00 am. The interview is to engage visiting faculty for temporary posts in four six-month courses. The courses are Certificate in Traditional Art Appreciation, Certificate in Academic Art Study, Certificate in Multimedia Design and Certificate in Video Graphy and Editing. content_sections.heading: About MLSU
content_sections.text: Mohanlal Sukhadia University (MLSU) is a university in Udaipur, Rajasthan. The notice comes from its Department of Visual Arts, which is part of UCSSH. The department runs a Skill Development Centre under the RUSA 2.0 Project, and the visiting faculty engaged through this notice will teach that centre's six-month courses.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Submit the duly filled application form to this address: Department of Visual Arts, M.L. Sukhadia University, Udaipur 313001 (Raj.). The notice does not say whether the form should be sent by post or delivered by hand. For the detailed terms and conditions and the prescribed proforma, the notice refers candidates to the University website, www.mlsu.ac.in. The form is titled "Application Form for Empanelment/ Engagement of Guest Faculty (Period Basis) for the Session 2026-27". faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MLSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies, 1 for each post, because the notice does not print a number. The posts are visiting faculty for Certificate in Traditional Art Appreciation, Certificate in Academic Art Study, Certificate in Multimedia Design, and Certificate in Video Graphy and Editing.

faq.question: Q2. When is the MLSU visiting faculty walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 13 November 2026 at 11:00 am. It is for the Skill Development Centre at the Department of Visual Arts, UCSSH, MLSU.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for MLSU visiting faculty?
faq.answer: The notice states: "Minimum qualification Diploma, PG/ Graduation in specific subject." It also asks for experience in specific format.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MLSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is max. 60 years for all four posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200, or Rs. 100 for SC/ST/EWS/PWD categories. You can pay by Demand Draft, Cash or Online, in favour of Dean, UCSSH, MLSU, Udaipur (Raj.).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for MLSU visiting faculty posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form (Part A in your own handwriting) and attach the self-attested documents and the fee. Then submit it to the Department of Visual Arts, M.L. Sukhadia University, Udaipur 313001 (Raj.).

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of MLSU visiting faculty?
faq.answer: Visiting faculty are paid for teaching assignments on a period basis, at the rates of honorarium approved by the University.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MLSU visiting faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is temporary and can be ended at any time without notice. The form is for guest faculty (period basis) for the session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired teachers apply for MLSU visiting faculty posts?
faq.answer: Yes. The application form lets applicants tick "Retired teacher from University/College", "Teacher working in other institution" or "Others".

faq.question: Q10. Is T.A./D.A. paid for attending the MLSU interview?
faq.answer: No. The application form states that no T.A./D.A. will be paid for attending the interview.
